newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures firm late on fund support.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures firm late on fund support.

text.p: CME lumber futures slipped after a higher start but worked their way back up and finished strong on fund support, traders said.
Lumber closed $2.20 to $4.00 per tbf higher with July up the least at $380.20 and September up $2.70 at $374.00 after trading in a $6.00 range during the day.

Early resistance from reports cash was trading at a sharp discount in the secondary market lacked followthrough and prices moved higher. Locals continued to support July and sold September late to keep the spread from narrowing any further, traders said.
The holiday in Canada kept overall interest in the market very light, they added.
